title: Geometric dg scalar extension with its balanced unit
statement: Let two small ringed sites have commutative coefficient sheaves and dg algebras $A,B$ as in [def-sfb-sheaf-dg-module-localization]. Let $L$ be the inverse-image functor of a geometric morphism of their sheaf topoi, as in [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. A pulled algebra map $LA\to B$ is an additive degreewise map of underlying inverse-image sheaves commuting with differentials, multiplication and unit. All operations are transported by testing generalized elements of arbitrary sheaves, not just global sections. For right dg modules $P,M$ [def-sfb-sheaf-dg-free-closed-generators], a pulled semilinear module map $a:LP\to M$ is an additive degreewise map commuting with differentials and satisfying $a(pa)=a(p)\varphi(a)$ on all generalized sections. The pair $(M,a)$ is a geometric scalar extension if every semilinear dg map $LP\to N$ factors uniquely through $a$ by a $B$-linear dg map $M\to N$, and postcomposition with every such map is semilinear. This is the universal property, with its unit $p\mapsto p\otimes1$, of $LP\otimes_{LA}B$. On graded set sheaves inverse image is applied to each fibre. For $P=F_A(E)$ and $M=F_B(LE)$ the free-base-change normalization is $L(s\mapsto s1)\,;a=(Ls\mapsto (Ls)1)$ in each degree.
